summary: Let N be the number of distinct nonzero input colors and expand every input cell to an N by N block. Nonzero cells become solid same-color blocks. For a zero cell, inspect NW, NE, SW, SE diagonal neighbours in that order; the first in-bounds nonzero neighbour whose two intervening orthogonal cells are zero controls the block, drawing red on the main diagonal for NW/SE or the anti diagonal for NE/SW. A zero cell with no eligible neighbour remains black.
